summary.name: Neo4j
summary.one_liner: Neo4j is a graph database and graph intelligence platform for storing connected data and building knowledge layers and GraphRAG for AI agents.
use_cases: building agentic GraphRAG for LLM apps
giving AI agents explainable context and memory
tracing decisions back to source data
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes Neo4j as a graph data platform that stores data as nodes and relationships rather than tables, and presents it as a knowledge layer for AI systems. It describes Agentic GraphRAG for producing explainable LLM outputs and a Neo4j Context Engine that governs agent answers and steps. It also describes knowledge graphs and context graphs as concepts, and points to Neo4j AuraDB as the fully managed graph database option. Most of the text is marketing claims with headline statistics (such as fewer hallucinations and ROI figures attributed to IDC) that are not independently verified here.
notable: Agentic GraphRAG for explainable LLM outputs
Neo4j Context Engine for governed agent answers
Neo4j AuraDB fully managed graph database
Listed in awesome-mac under Databases as open source and freeware
caveats: Headline statistics (44% fewer hallucinations, 230% ROI, 7.8-month payback) are vendor/IDC claims stated on the marketing page
Pricing for the platform and AuraDB is not stated on this page
